build-storybook.//: `@nx/storybook/plugin` defaults the output to `{projectRoot}/storybook-static`, which puts a build artifact INSIDE the source tree — and Storybook 10 writes a telemetry file named `project.json` into it. Three workspace gates then break for anyone who has ever built Storybook: `lint-invariants.spec.mjs` globs `{apps,libs,e2e,scripts}/**/project.json` and finds the artifact, `pnpm stylelint` globs `{apps,libs}/**/*.{scss,css}` and lints the generated CSS, and this project's own `eslint .` descends into it. Sending the output to `dist/` fixes all three at the root: every one of those globs already stops at `apps`/`libs`, and `.gitignore` + ESLint's `globalIgnores` already cover `/dist`. The path is relative because run-commands runs `storybook build` with cwd = the project root; `outputs` is restated workspace-relative because Nx interpolates `{options.output-dir}` against the workspace root, where `../../../` would escape it.

static-storybook.//: The plugin hard-codes `staticFilePath` to `{projectRoot}/storybook-static`; it does not read `output-dir` above, so moving the build without moving this would serve a directory that no longer exists. `@nx/web:file-server` resolves the path from the workspace root.
